AReading: Sprint 14 Review
Read the summary email, then choose the correct answer for each question.

Subject: Sprint 14 review — summary

Hi all, here is a short summary of yesterday's sprint review. We have completed eight of the ten items in the sprint backlog. The data migration has been finished ahead of schedule, and the new dashboard has already been shown to the customer, who was very happy with the KPI visualisations. Two items — the export function and the user documentation — have been moved to the next sprint.

The retrospective identified one recurring problem: tickets are often blocked because the test environment is unstable. Daniel is going to set up a second environment next week, which should solve the issue. Sprint 15 starts on Monday. The planning meeting will take place at 10:00, and Maria will present the updated product backlog. Please update your tickets in the repository before then. — Jonas

2. The data migration was finished .
3. The customer was very happy with .
4. The recurring problem identified in the retrospective is .

6. Before Monday's planning meeting, the team should .
